item.title: Injured Jockey Report - Ella Drew (Gunnedah)
item.description: Apprentice jockey Ella Drew was dislodged from her mount during the running of Race 2 at Gunnedah. She has a suspected concussion and right arm injury & will be transported to hospital for further examination.

item.title: Coonamble 15th March Transferred To Dubbo
item.description: Due to difficulties with track preparation occasioned by lack of recent rain and effects of reliance on effluent water, the race meeting scheduled for Coonamble on Sunday 15 March 2026, featuring the Western Region Country Championships, has been transferred to Dubbo. No changes are required to the distances of races on the program.
